dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I find it hard to believe that you came here for leisure alone. After all, this is the very same Jade Chamber that you helped to rebuild.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: All intel heretofore gathered indicates that no one comes to the Jade Chamber without good reason. This rule has yet to see exception.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: As Lady Ningguang's secretary and one in charge of collecting and organizing intelligence, I must strive to get a handle on the information of all guests, even ones as esteemed as yourself.
